beats.text: A sub-agent that reads one report needs about three hundred and **sixty-four** tokens. With ninety-nine other reports it needs nearly fourteen **thousand**.
All **eighty-four** runs were exactly right. I saw no context rot at this size. The saving was **thirty-eight** times fewer tokens.
Visual search works too. Of the four nearest DINOv3 neighbours, **seventy-three** percent share the part class. Random neighbours: **ten** percent.
But with twenty small records, the plain **payload** was cheapest. Small results do not need **offloading**.
